+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+from gettext import gettext as _
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Context
+from .formatting import HelpFormatter
+
+
+class VerticalTabHelp(Command):
+    """A :class:`Command` that truncates its help text at the first
+    vertical tab (``\\v``) instead of the first form feed (``\\f``).
+    """
+
+    def format_help_text(self, ctx: Context, formatter: HelpFormatter) -> None:
+        """Writes the help text to the formatter if it exists."""
+        if self.help is not None:
+            # truncate the help text to the first vertical tab
+            text = inspect.cleandoc(self.help).partition("\v")[0]
+        else:
+            text = ""
+
+        if self.deprecated:
+            deprecated_message = (
+                f"(DEPRECATED: {self.deprecated})"
+                if isinstance(self.deprecated, str)
+                else "(DEPRECATED)"
+            )
+            text = _("{text} {deprecated_message}").format(
+                text=text, deprecated_message=deprecated_message
+            )
+
+        if text:
+            formatter.write_paragraph()
+
+            with formatter.indentation():
+                formatter.write_text(text)
